assets.name: gate
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent pixel-art RPG map object, NOT a scene. Create one ENORMOUS OLD DEFENSIVE STONE GATEHOUSE, the dominant landmark of ancient abandoned ruins. Fixed orthographic 3/4 overhead RPG camera looking from south: horizontal lintels stay horizontal, vertical tower walls stay vertical, NOT isometric diamond geometry. Strong readable depth: massive chunky ashlar masonry, thick walls and projecting square bastions, wide roof/parapet top surfaces visible above tall shaded front walls, black weathered arrow slits. Twin unequal fortified towers flanking ONE broad central open arched through-passage, no doors closing it. It once withstood sieges. Today its upper-right battlement and half of one tower are collapsed, huge chipped corners and deep cracks, exposed rough masonry core, scattered rubble still attached at base, dark moss clumps and trailing ivy in joints. Broken crenellations, thick arch voussoirs and an old fallen portcullis pushed to the side. Passage must be genuinely transparent through its LOWER central arch so map ground and a player can be seen through it; no filled black or green doorway. Heavy ancient military structure, NOT thin classical columns, NOT a decorative ceremonial portal. Cohesive desaturated olive-gray and warm gray stone, muted moss, deep brown cracks. 1990s 32px-grid top-down fantasy RPG pixel art, crisp chunky hard-edged pixel clusters and limited palette; target object approximately 480 by 384 game pixels with enough large texture features to read at that scale. Transparent RGBA canvas, object centered, entire building visible including base rubble, modest transparent margin, no landscape or ground plate, no characters, no labels, no text, no grid lines, no cast-shadow rectangle, no clean maintained surfaces.

passes.initial: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent pixel-art RPG building sprite. Input image 1 is the edit target, an abandoned mossy gray-stone house with a half-collapsed russet-tile roof. Correct ONLY the camera orientation, retaining its materials, colors, age, substantial volume and roof damage. CAMERA REQUIREMENT: fixed orthographic view looking due NORTH from the SOUTH, camera pitched DOWN exactly 45 degrees from horizontal, ZERO horizontal rotation/yaw. We see roof TOP plus SOUTH FRONT facade ONLY. Neither east nor west exterior SIDE WALL may be visible. Front wall is a broad rectangle with its bottom edge perfectly HORIZONTAL, roof ridge and eaves perfectly HORIZONTAL, vertical corners VERTICAL. Both front corners have the SAME screen y coordinate. No three-quarter yaw, no isometric view, no diagonal facade edges, no visible end gable or side-wall face. The roof slopes away from viewer toward a horizontal rear ridge, showing only the front roof slope. Keep the left half of this roof caved in with jagged broken roof tiles, exposed rafters and dark upper room, right roof half mossy and intact enough to read as a roof, crumbling chimney on right, irregular small front windows, battered central front door, chipped olive-gray masonry and attached rubble. Camera elevation supplies depth through the visible roof surface, thick broken wall tops and dark rafters, NOT a visible exterior side. Complete isolated object on genuine transparent RGBA background, include full footprint and chimney with modest margin. Crisp chunky 1990s RPG pixel art suitable for export to 288x256 pixels, same warm gray/olive stone, dark russet tiles, muted moss palette as reference. No text, labels, grid, ground plate, scenery or cast-shadow rectangle.
passes.final: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: input house sprite. Make ONE further correction: REMOVE ALL VISIBLE LEFT EXTERIOR SIDE WALL, so camera is centered exactly in front of the SOUTH wall with 45-degree downward pitch and ZERO yaw. In this reference the front-left corner is inset from the left silhouette, revealing a broad left side wall. THIS IS WRONG. Move the front-left corner out to the left building edge, make left and right front corners equally aligned, keep front wall bottom and top horizontal. The building must present just one flat front facade rectangle below the roof, extending across full width; the front windows and door are on that ONE plane. NO perpendicular exterior wall plane at either side. No left-facing gable wall, no left-side roof triangle. The visible roof should be one rectangle in screen projection, with horizontal ridge behind and horizontal front eave, near-vertical parallel outer roof edges; damage can break those outlines. This is the standard due-south-facing top-down RPG building sprite, NOT an isometric building. Preserve the mossy russet roof and huge collapsed section on the left, dark exposed rafters and upper room, substantial chipped olive-gray masonry, right chimney, abandoned unmaintained condition, front door/two windows, attached rubble, chunky pixel-art texture and palette. Entire isolated object, fully in frame, genuine transparent background, no text, scenery, groundplate or grid. Crucial: only FRONT wall and ROOF TOP are visible, no exterior SIDE wall at all.
